verdict.rationale: AnyDesk's own management console and REST API document monitoring sessions, seeing active sessions and online status, closing an active session, and removing a client from the license, which covers seeing and cutting off connections and revoking devices. All of this runs from the my.anydesk console or API rather than from the host itself, and nothing shows the host displaying the identity of whoever is currently connected. Missing for 10: host-side display of the currently connected user or device, a disconnect/revoke control on the host itself, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user, the host shows who is connected right now, and I can disconnect or revoke a device from the host
